verdict.rationale: Debuggability through real DOM output is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence on it: vue-docs-3 says only that Vue builds on standard HTML/CSS/JS, vue-docs-4 describes a compiler-optimized rendering system without saying what it outputs, and vue-docs-9 is a bare 'Tooling Guide' title. Nothing addresses rendering real DOM nodes or debugging in browser devtools.
